project.name: TutRec
project.description: A web application that helps freelance tutors manage one-on-one students and group batches, track payments, automate email reminders, and generate financial reports.
project.targetUsers: Freelance tutors in Pakistan, India, UK, USA and other countries who teach online, in-person, or hybrid.
project.businessModel: Freemium SaaS. The tutor pays for the platform. Students get free access to a minimal portal. No payment gateways in MVP — students submit payment proof (screenshots), tutors approve manually.

coreProblemsSolved: Tutors manually track who has paid and who hasn't
No automated reminders for overdue payments
No structured way to manage sessions across students and group classes
Physical and online classes mixed together with no tracking
Business expenses not tracked, so real profit is unknown
Parents and students constantly messaging tutors for basic info like next class time or what was covered

designSystem.philosophy: Interactive but minimal. Clean layouts, purposeful animations, no clutter. Every element earns its place. Feels like a professional daily-use tool, not a feature dump.

darkModeRequirements: Dark mode is a first-class citizen, not an afterthought
No hardcoded hex values in components — use Tailwind CSS variables or theme config so dark mode is maintainable

accentColors.note: Accent colors stay the same across light and dark mode

navigation.desktop: Fixed sidebar, deep navy background in both light and dark mode, white text and icons, active item highlighted with electric blue left border + blue tint background

components.cards: Rounded corners 12px, white in light mode, #0F1F3D in dark mode, very subtle shadow
components.buttons: Rounded 8px. Primary = electric blue, Secondary = outlined, Danger = rose
components.statusBadges: Pill-style. Paid = emerald, Due = amber, Overdue = rose, Neutral = slate
components.tables: Clean rows, subtle hover background, no heavy borders
components.modals: Centered, backdrop blur, clean header with close button
components.charts: Recharts, accent palette colors, no chart borders, smooth curves
components.inputs: Navy border in dark mode, grey border in light mode, electric blue focus ring
components.loaders: Skeleton loaders on data fetch, not spinners
components.emptyStates: Icon or illustration + short message + primary action button

motion.buttonHover: Slight brightness lift, no scale transform
motion.charts: Animate on mount using Recharts built-in animation

studentPortal.access: Unique token URL per student per tutor: tutrec.io/portal/[token]
studentPortal.note: Token in URL is the authentication. If a student has two tutors both using TutRec, they get two separate portal links — one per tutor. Unified multi-tutor portal is post-MVP.
features: View session notes (read-only, written by tutor)
Mark attendance for past sessions ('I attended' / 'I couldn't attend')
View outstanding balance if payment due
Select payment method (Bank Transfer, Easypaisa, JazzCash, Cash, Other)
Submit payment proof (file upload + notes), status shows 'Pending review'

technicalNotes: Physical classes are first-class. Sessions have classMode (online/physical) and a location field for physical venues — important for tutors teaching at home, an academy, or a student's house.
Email templates are stored in the database and editable by tutors, not hardcoded. Variables are replaced at send time.
No payment gateway in MVP. Students upload payment proof (screenshot/receipt). Tutors approve or reject. Money never flows through TutRec — this keeps it globally compatible and regulation-free.
Two ways to mark a student as paid: (1) tutor marks paid directly with no proof, or (2) student submits proof and tutor approves.

Student portal is token-based with no login required. Token is in the URL. A student with two tutors on TutRec gets two separate portal links, one per tutor. Unified multi-tutor portal is a post-MVP feature.

Multi-currency from day one. Every fee and expense has its own currency. All values convert to the tutor's base currency for reporting. Exchange rates are entered manually in Settings (no live FX sync in MVP).
A student can be in a batch AND have individual sessions simultaneously.
Payment status logic: status = 'paid' if approved within current billing cycle; 'due' if planExpiryDate is today or future; 'overdue' if planExpiryDate is in the past.
Dark mode must be built with theme variables from the start (Tailwind CSS variables or equivalent), not retrofitted — avoid hardcoded hex colors in components.
outOfScopeForMVP: Unified student portal across multiple tutors
Student LMS features (homework submission, video library, course content)
Google Calendar or Zoom API integration
Advanced analytics (churn prediction, lifetime value, etc.)
openQuestionsForDevTeam: Email provider preference: Resend (simpler) or Nodemailer with SMTP?
File storage: AWS S3 or Firebase Storage?
Database hosting: Railway-managed PostgreSQL or AWS RDS?
Timezone handling: store all dates in UTC, display in tutor's local timezone on frontend?
Batch fees: do all students in a batch pay the same fee? (assume yes for MVP)
Session completion: auto-mark completed after scheduled time passes, or manual tutor action? (assume auto for MVP)
Rate limiting: enable per-user API rate limits?
Concurrent sessions: one active login per tutor account for MVP?
Testing scope: unit + integration tests only, or end-to-end as well?
